title: Magento 2 cron_schedule at 14M rows: a Friday postmortem
lede: A Magento 2 shop's cron_schedule table hit 14 million rows on a Friday afternoon. Here is the prune, the lock duration we accepted, and the indexer config that stopped the regrowth.
hero_alt: Overhead still life on bone linen: paper run-sheet, SQL prune sheet, manila folder, brass key, ER diagram, wax seal.
